info.title: API.SH: Correios
info.description: The Correios API from API.SH: public Correios data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Correios post offices (own agencies and franchised AGFs) of a city, optionally one district: name, address, district, CEP, coordinates and a directions link, the Clique e Retire pickup CEP, extra service points, opening hours by day group, posting cut-off time, Saturday and Sunday opening and on-call flags, digital-certificate, CPF and lost-and-found services. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/correios-agencies

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name (accents and case ignored) or its code from /correios/v1/cities.

parameters.name: open_saturday
parameters.description: true: only agencies open on Saturday; false: only those closed.

parameters.name: open_sunday
parameters.description: true: only agencies open on Sunday; false: only those closed.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The US dollar and euro rates Correios uses for international shipments: BRL per unit, units per BRL, quote time and validity date, plus the rates of the last few business days.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/correios-exchange-rates

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Prices and delivery windows for sending a parcel or document abroad from Brazil with Correios (Exporta Fácil Standard, Economic and Express and the document services): per service the final price, service and insurance price in BRL, minimum, maximum and average delivery days, availability and the envelope, box and roll size limits. For the United States and Puerto Rico it also returns the estimated import duties and fees with their breakdown; goods sent there need at least one item. Countries: /correios/v1/countries.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/correios-international-quote

parameters.name: item_name
parameters.description: One item: its name (required with item_value for goods to the US or Puerto Rico).

parameters.name: item_value
parameters.description: One item: its value in BRL.

parameters.name: item_ncm
parameters.description: One item: its 8-digit NCM (HS) code, used for the duty estimate.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Several items instead of item_*: a JSON list like [{"name":"T-shirt","quantity":2,"value":50,"ncm":"61091000"}] (up to 30).

parameters.name: posting_card
parameters.description: A Correios contract posting card number, to quote contract prices.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tracking history of one Correios object (domestic or international), as the public tracking page shows it: service (category, name, code), current status, whether it was delivered, expected delivery date and a late flag, import-charge, locker and blocked flags, and every event (code, type, description, detail, date and time in Brasília time, the unit with its type, city and state, and the destination unit for transfers). An unknown code answers 404. One object per call.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/correios-track

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Tracking code: 2 letters, 9 digits, 2 letters (e.g. AA123456789BR). Spaces and dashes are ignored.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
